WITH entry_times AS (
            SELECT user_id, MIN(timestamp) AS first_entry
            FROM events
            WHERE event_name = 'page_view' AND timestamp >= '2023-01-01 00:00:00' AND timestamp <= '2024-12-31 23:59:59'
            GROUP BY user_id
        ),
        converted_users AS (
            SELECT DISTINCT e.user_id
            FROM events e
            JOIN entry_times et ON e.user_id = et.user_id
            WHERE e.event_name = 'purchase' AND timestamp >= '2023-01-01 00:00:00' AND timestamp <= '2024-12-31 23:59:59'
            AND e.timestamp > et.first_entry
        )
        SELECT
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM entry_times)     AS total_users,
            (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM converted_users) AS converted_users
